verdict.rationale: Linear's API is GraphQL rather than REST, so the equivalent machine-readable spec is the GraphQL schema. Linear documents that its endpoint supports introspection of the whole schema, publishes the full SDL in its official repo (packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql, kept current by a GitHub Action), and offers schema browsing in Apollo Studio. Schema deprecations are annotated with @deprecated. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of downloading and using the schema.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
The full schema SDL is also published in the official linear/linear repo at packages/sdk/src/schema.graphql (kept current by the repo's schema GitHub Action).
Click the Schema tab to browse the schema, and click the Explorer tab to run queries.
We utilize the `@deprecated` directive to annotate deprecation warnings in the schema.
